== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Holotable (Japanese)|Imperial Holotable]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/jp/imagegallery/4722 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 135901778.

Crop rectangle <code>(34, 618, 1299, 2238)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>aea9791262296bc5148d340a4127545ac2245217f34a36a1e1341264d7e3c810</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
